unresolved_contract_gaps.title: RG-04 operation registry
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The v2 action registry has no closed top-level action_type/operation_class pairs or strict inputs for manual mixed-expense creation, credit-principal repayment, mixed-payment source intake, candidate completion and confirmation, mirror-evidence merge, incomplete intake, rejected attempts, and their no-change retries.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register closed actions with these discriminators: manual_mixed_expense/creation, credit_principal_repayment/creation, ingest_mixed_payment_source/creation for complete and incomplete payloads, confirm_mixed_payment_candidate/creation, merge_mixed_payment_mirror_evidence/reconciliation, manual_mixed_expense/rejection, and no-change retries retaining the original action/class. Require strict input or sparse attempted_input, deterministic IDs, explicit confirmation where frozen, complete deltas, and no hidden balancing or automatic confirmation.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Leaving kind inside an open input or using a generic retry would make dispatch ambiguous, weaken rejected-input closure, and permit unconfirmed or duplicate formal effects.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Mixed-payment source and candidate payloads
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The current source and candidate unions only admit balance-adjustment records and cannot serialize complete or missing-leg mixed-payment facts, provenance, confidence, confirmation requirements, or status history.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register closed complete and incomplete mixed-payment source payloads plus mixed-payment expense candidate payloads that preserve total, currency, category suggestion, known funding facts, missing amount, provenance, confidence, source identities, and explicit confirmation requirements.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Without closed payloads the migration would either discard import facts or guess the missing liability funding account, violating the pending-confirmation and zero-formal-effect rules.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Mixed-funding and credit-repayment posting roles
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The transaction registry includes expense and credit_repayment, but the posting-role registry cannot distinguish an expense asset funding leg, expense credit-liability funding leg, repayment asset outflow, and repayment liability principal reduction.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register canonical posting roles and cross-entity validation for the three-posting mixed expense and two-posting principal repayment while retaining exact per-currency balance and posting-level reconciliation eligibility.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Generic or transfer roles would blur financing from cash flow and could count credit principal repayment as consumption a second time.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: mixed_payment relation and funding components
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: mixed_payment is reserved in documentation, but the v2 relation schema is false; it cannot distinguish relation.type from stable instance ID or express the purchase transaction and two existing real-account funding postings through canonical member_refs.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register a closed mixed_payment relation with stable instance id, type, member_refs, and payload. member_refs must contain exactly one existing purchase transaction and its two existing funding postings. funding_components carry account, positive display amount, currency, and the same member posting reference without an independent component ID; payload also carries display/system flags and composition total.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Using mixed_payment as relation.id, keeping endpoints only in payload, or assigning component identities would break stable relation identity, weaken reference validation, and risk duplicate postings or a second economic event during mirror merge.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Financial funding evidence subtypes
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The existing real_account_posting evidence-link role and reconciliation projections are sufficient, but the evidence union has no subtype for the asset debit or later credit-liability mirror record used by RG-04.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register closed source-linked financial funding evidence subtypes carrying observed_at and validate real_account_posting links to the exact asset or liability posting; mirror intake may add only source, evidence, link, and reconciliation changes.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Using an unrelated evidence subtype or transaction-level match could falsely verify both funding legs or create a duplicate transaction when mirror evidence arrives.
